name: Colorado Festival of Horror
blurb: A home-grown, fan-run horror convention and film festival in Denver, Colorado, with a different theme each year.
notes: The homepage now speaks of 2026 in the past tense ('A huge thank you to all of our amazing guests... for making 2026 such a great success'; 'was back for its sixth terrifying year'), confirming the Sept 18-20, 2026 run at the Denver Marriott Tech Center already happened; no 2027 date has been announced, so editions is empty and that run is recorded as 'last'. No og/twitter image exists; the cover uses the site's own logo rather than the homepage's attendee/crowd photos. Guests were not extracted since there is no current or upcoming edition to attach them to.
